caption: The drawing features two rectangular textile designs, both composed of repeated patterns with green, red, and blue on a tan or cream-colored background. The larger, upper rectangle contains a stylized, curved bird outlined in green and blue, with crosshatch detailing and a prominent eye. Around the bird's body, there is a dense arrangement of symmetrical foliage and flowers in red, green, and blue, including scrolling vines and leaf forms. Near the bottom of this rectangle, there is a decorative border with uppercase text in green against the background, reading: "M.BY HISLAGER MOUNT & CO. MASTERS CO. FAWARRANTED FAST COLOLR." The smaller, lower rectangle, located below and to the right of the larger one, contains a segment of the same or similar pattern, primarily displaying a blue and red flower, green leaves, and a portion of the tan background. The entire drawing is centered on a larger plain off-white page, with a handwritten label "FLORENCE MILTO" below the main design.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
